description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EntityDeleteFormTrait' used in Drupal for handling entity deletion forms, including methods for generating confirmation questions, messages, URLs, and logging deletion events.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Generates a confirmation question asking if the user wants to delete the entity, including entity type and label.

methods.name: getDeletionMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the entity has been deleted.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to cancel deletion, typically the entity collection page.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to redirect after deletion, defaulting to the front page if no collection URL is available.

methods.name: logDeletionMessage
methods.description: Logs an informational message that the entity has been deleted.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to delete the entity, show a status message, redirect, and log the deletion.
